source_text: It’s been a few days since I’ve had a proper stretch.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx#>.It’s been a few days since I’ve had a proper stretch.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx#>.It’s been a few days since I’ve had a proper stretch."

translation: Minęło kilka dni, odkąd porządnie się rozciągałam.

source_text: Ah, to be young again.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Ah, to be young again.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Ah, to be young again."

translation: Ach, znów być młodą.

source_text: Enjoy it while it lasts, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Enjoy it while it lasts, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Enjoy it while it lasts, 1Hero."

translation: Korzystaj, póki możesz, 1Hero.

source_text: Nice form, Miss Kimura.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp#>.Nice form, Miss Kimura.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp#>.Nice form, Miss Kimura."

translation: Świetna forma, panno Kimura.

source_text: It takes a lot of patience and discipline to achieve this flexibility at my age.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp!c.It takes a lot of patience and discipline to achieve this flexibility at my age.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp!c.It takes a lot of patience and discipline to achieve this flexibility at my age."

translation: Osiągnięcie takiej elastyczności w moim wieku wymaga cierpliwości i dyscypliny.

source_text: I like what I’m seeing.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I like what I’m seeing.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I like what I’m seeing."

translation: Podoba mi się ten widok.

source_text: You should be focused, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp#.You should be focused, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp#.You should be focused, 1Hero."

translation: Powinieneś się skupić, 1Hero.

source_text: I’m focused, for sure.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I’m focused, for sure.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I’m focused, for sure."

translation: Jestem skupiony, bez dwóch zdań.

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. You need to use those back muscles.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp#.Come on, 1Hero. You need to use those back muscles.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp#.Come on, 1Hero. You need to use those back muscles."

translation: No dalej, 1Hero. Użyj mięśni pleców.

source_text: Uhh… Sure thing, Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McHuCl.Uhh… Sure thing, Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McHuCl.Uhh… Sure thing, Andrea."

translation: Eee… Jasne, Andreo.

source_text: I thought you said you’ve done this before.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.I thought you said you’ve done this before.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.I thought you said you’ve done this before."

translation: Mówiłeś, że już to robiłeś.

source_text: I guess I’m not as flexible as you are.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp#>.I guess I’m not as flexible as you are.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp#>.I guess I’m not as flexible as you are."

translation: Chyba nie jestem tak rozciągnięty jak ty.

source_text: Let me show you a back stretch that I think will benefit you.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Let me show you a back stretch that I think will benefit you.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Let me show you a back stretch that I think will benefit you."

translation: Pokażę ci ćwiczenie rozciągające plecy, które może ci pomóc.

source_text: Think you can handle this one, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp#.Think you can handle this one, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp#.Think you can handle this one, 1Hero?"

translation: Myślisz, że dasz sobie z tym radę, 1Hero?

source_text: I want you to press down on my stomach. Give me some resistance.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.I want you to press down on my stomach. Give me some resistance.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.I want you to press down on my stomach. Give me some resistance."

translation: Naciśnij na mój brzuch. Stawiaj lekki opór.

source_text: Is this too much?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp#>.Is this too much?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp#>.Is this too much?"

translation: Nie za mocno?

source_text: I can take it, 1Hero…

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.I can take it, 1Hero…
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.I can take it, 1Hero…"

translation: Wytrzymam, 1Hero…

source_text: An exercise like this really strengthens the back while loosening the spine at the same time.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.An exercise like this really strengthens the back while loosening the spine at the same time.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.An exercise like this really strengthens the back while loosening the spine at the same time."

translation: Takie ćwiczenie wzmacnia plecy i jednocześnie rozluźnia kręgosłup.

source_text: You can handle a lot of pressure, Miss Kimura.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx#>.You can handle a lot of pressure, Miss Kimura.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx#>.You can handle a lot of pressure, Miss Kimura."

translation: Dużo wytrzymujesz, panno Kimura.

source_text: I demand from myself a strong body and mind.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.I demand from myself a strong body and mind.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.I demand from myself a strong body and mind."

translation: Wymagam od siebie silnego ciała i umysłu.

source_text: You’ve got very tight abs.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.You’ve got very tight abs.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.You’ve got very tight abs."

translation: Masz bardzo jędrne mięśnie brzucha.

source_text: Not bad for a woman well past forty.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Not bad for a woman well past forty.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Not bad for a woman well past forty."

translation: Nieźle jak na kobietę po czterdziestce.

source_text: You don’t look a day past twenty-five.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.You don’t look a day past twenty-five.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.You don’t look a day past twenty-five."

translation: Nie dałbym ci więcej niż dwadzieścia pięć lat.

source_text: You’re a charmer, 1Hero. No doubt.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.You’re a charmer, 1Hero. No doubt.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.You’re a charmer, 1Hero. No doubt."

translation: Ale z ciebie czaruś, 1Hero. Bez dwóch zdań.

source_text: If you’ll excuse me, Miss Kimura. I must get back to my office.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx#.If you’ll excuse me, Miss Kimura. I must get back to my office.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx#.If you’ll excuse me, Miss Kimura. I must get back to my office."

translation: Proszę wybaczyć, panno Kimura. Muszę wrócić do biura.

source_text: Yes, Miss Bhatt. I enjoyed our talk.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Yes, Miss Bhatt. I enjoyed our talk.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Yes, Miss Bhatt. I enjoyed our talk."

translation: Oczywiście, panno Bhatt. Miło mi się z panią rozmawiało.

source_text: Don’t you want to join us in some yoga?

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Don’t you want to join us in some yoga?
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Don’t you want to join us in some yoga?"

translation: Nie chcesz do nas dołączyć i poćwiczyć jogi?

source_text: I’m afraid I don’t have time and I suggest you return to your desk soon, 1Hero. It’s a late start for you.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.I’m afraid I don’t have time and I suggest you return to your desk soon, 1Hero. It’s a late start for you.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.I’m afraid I don’t have time and I suggest you return to your desk soon, 1Hero. It’s a late start for you."

translation: Niestety, nie mam czasu. Radzę ci niedługo wrócić do biurka, 1Hero. Zaczynasz dziś późno.

source_text: Don’t upset your boss, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Don’t upset your boss, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Don’t upset your boss, 1Hero."

translation: Nie denerwuj swojej szefowej, 1Hero.

source_text: Sure, Miss Bhatt. I won’t be much longer.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Sure, Miss Bhatt. I won’t be much longer.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Sure, Miss Bhatt. I won’t be much longer."

translation: Oczywiście, panno Bhatt. Zaraz kończę.

source_text: I can see the tension between you two.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx#.I can see the tension between you two.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx#.I can see the tension between you two."

translation: Widzę, że między wami iskrzy.

source_text: Melissa and I don’t always get along.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Melissa and I don’t always get along.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Melissa and I don’t always get along."

translation: Nie zawsze dogaduję się z Melissą.

source_text: You’re going above her. You have an appetite for independence.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.You’re going above her. You have an appetite for independence.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.You’re going above her. You have an appetite for independence."

translation: Przeskakujesz ją w hierarchii. Chcesz działać na własną rękę.

source_text: I want to do more. She’s holding me back.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I want to do more. She’s holding me back.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I want to do more. She’s holding me back."

translation: Chcę robić więcej. Ona mnie powstrzymuje.

source_text: Hold on to that fire, 1Hero. But also, know your place.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Hold on to that fire, 1Hero. But also, know your place.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Hold on to that fire, 1Hero. But also, know your place."

translation: Nie trać zapału, 1Hero. Ale pamiętaj też, gdzie twoje miejsce.

source_text: I’m not going to let you down, Miss Kimura.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’m not going to let you down, Miss Kimura.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’m not going to let you down, Miss Kimura."

translation: Nie zawiodę pani, panno Kimura.

source_text: My future is here.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.My future is here.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.My future is here."

translation: Moja przyszłość jest tutaj.

source_text: If you’re playing games to get under Melissa’s skin, it’s working.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.If you’re playing games to get under Melissa’s skin, it’s working.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.If you’re playing games to get under Melissa’s skin, it’s working."

translation: Jeśli próbujesz zajść Melissie za skórę, to ci się udaje.

source_text: Huh? I don’t know what you mean.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Huh? I don’t know what you mean.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Huh? I don’t know what you mean."

translation: Co? Nie wiem, o co ci chodzi.

source_text: Don’t play dumb. I see everything…

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Don’t play dumb. I see everything…
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Don’t play dumb. I see everything…"

translation: Nie udawaj głupiego. Wszystko widzę…

source_text: I didn’t get here on my looks alone.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.I didn’t get here on my looks alone.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.I didn’t get here on my looks alone."

translation: Nie zaszłam tak daleko wyłącznie dzięki urodzie.

source_text: But certainly it doesn’t hurt to be sexy. Am I right?

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.But certainly it doesn’t hurt to be sexy. Am I right?
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.But certainly it doesn’t hurt to be sexy. Am I right?"

translation: Ale seksowny wygląd na pewno nie przeszkadza. Prawda?

source_text: 1Hero! You better be careful.

structure.raw_value: AdShOpNo1.1Hero! You better be careful.
structure.script_literal: "AdShOpNo1.1Hero! You better be careful."

translation: 1Hero! Lepiej uważaj.

source_text: I’m your man, Andrea. I’ve got what it takes to make a difference. I just know it.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.I’m your man, Andrea. I’ve got what it takes to make a difference. I just know it.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.I’m your man, Andrea. I’ve got what it takes to make a difference. I just know it."

translation: Jestem po twojej stronie, Andreo. Mam wszystko, czego trzeba, żeby coś zmienić. Po prostu to wiem.

source_text: Go, 1Hero. Don’t upset Melissa.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Go, 1Hero. Don’t upset Melissa.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Go, 1Hero. Don’t upset Melissa."

translation: Idź już, 1Hero. Nie denerwuj Melissy.

source_text: Melissa?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe#>.Melissa?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe#>.Melissa?"

translation: Melisso?

source_text: 1Hero… Follow me.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.1Hero… Follow me.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.1Hero… Follow me."

translation: 1Hero… Chodź za mną.

source_text: Why do you insist on torturing me?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe#.Why do you insist on torturing me?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe#.Why do you insist on torturing me?"

translation: Czemu tak się upierasz, żeby mnie dręczyć?

source_text: What’s wrong? A man can’t do a little yoga in the morning?

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.What’s wrong? A man can’t do a little yoga in the morning?
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.What’s wrong? A man can’t do a little yoga in the morning?"

translation: Co jest? Facet nie może rano poćwiczyć jogi?

source_text: You came here on purpose. What’s your angle?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.You came here on purpose. What’s your angle?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.You came here on purpose. What’s your angle?"

translation: Przyszedłeś tu specjalnie. O co ci chodzi?

source_text: I need to stay on Kimura’s good side. Certainly you’d agree with that.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I need to stay on Kimura’s good side. Certainly you’d agree with that.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I need to stay on Kimura’s good side. Certainly you’d agree with that."

translation: Muszę utrzymać dobre relacje z Kimurą. Chyba się ze mną zgodzisz.

source_text: Flirting with the commissioner is not what I meant.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Flirting with the commissioner is not what I meant.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Flirting with the commissioner is not what I meant."

translation: Nie miałam na myśli flirtowania z komisarz.

source_text: I am certainly not!

structure.raw_value: MeMaAgNo1.I am certainly not!
structure.script_literal: "MeMaAgNo1.I am certainly not!"

translation: Wcale nie flirtuję!

source_text: Come on. My bad-boy attitude is just your thing. Isn’t it?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp#>.Come on. My bad-boy attitude is just your thing. Isn’t it?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp#>.Come on. My bad-boy attitude is just your thing. Isn’t it?"

translation: No dalej. Lubisz niegrzecznych chłopców, prawda?

source_text: You know, us younger guys are really into nice asses, and yours doesn’t disappoint.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.You know, us younger guys are really into nice asses, and yours doesn’t disappoint.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.You know, us younger guys are really into nice asses, and yours doesn’t disappoint."

translation: Wiesz, młodsi faceci lubią ładne tyłki, a twój nie zawodzi.

source_text: You… fucking child!

structure.raw_value: MeShClNo1.You… fucking child!
structure.script_literal: "MeShClNo1.You… fucking child!"

translation: Ty… gówniarzu!

source_text: Listen to me! My personal life is none of your business…

structure.raw_value: MeMaAg#No1.Listen to me! My personal life is none of your business…
structure.script_literal: "MeMaAg#No1.Listen to me! My personal life is none of your business…"

translation: Posłuchaj! Moje życie prywatne to nie twoja sprawa…

source_text: What you saw was a mistake and nothing more!

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.What you saw was a mistake and nothing more!
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.What you saw was a mistake and nothing more!"

translation: To, co widziałeś, było błędem i niczym więcej!

source_text: God, Melissa! I was just teasing. That hurts!

structure.raw_value: McHuCl.God, Melissa! I was just teasing. That hurts!
structure.script_literal: "McHuCl.God, Melissa! I was just teasing. That hurts!"

translation: Boże, Melisso! Tylko się droczyłem. To boli!

source_text: Good. Maybe I’ll rip it right off.

structure.raw_value: MeMaOp.Good. Maybe I’ll rip it right off.
structure.script_literal: "MeMaOp.Good. Maybe I’ll rip it right off."

translation: Dobrze. Może zaraz ci go urwę.

source_text: Ah! Ah! Let go!

structure.raw_value: McHuCl.Ah! Ah! Let go!
structure.script_literal: "McHuCl.Ah! Ah! Let go!"

translation: Ach! Ach! Puść mnie!
